series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. DS-40: Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

evidence.sentence: La CDN 3.0 de la Guinée fixe un objectif annuel pour 2035, avec une réduction des émissions de GES de 17 % (inconditionnelle) et de 49 % (conditionnelle) par rapport au scénario de référence pour l'ensemble de l'économie.
L'objectif de l'ITC est de réduire les émissions de gaz à effet de serre générées par le secteur minier de 20 % d'ici 2035 et de 30 % en 2040 par rapport au scénario de référence.

La CDN 3.0 de la Guinée définit des objectifs d'atténuation ambitieux, tous secteurs confondus, à savoir une réduction de 17 % par rapport au BAU de l'année de référence grâce à des mesures inconditionnelles et une réduction de 49 % grâce à des mesures conditionnelles à l'horizon 2035.

emissions_profile.$note: Headline totals are OWID only. OWID's CO₂ sub-totals are fossil/industrial CO₂ by fuel, not a full sectoral GHG breakdown, and do not sum to total_mtco2e. DS-05's rows are non-CO₂ gases only and are not comparable with the others; that is also why DS-05 is absent from series.observed, where a shorter curve would read as a disagreement rather than a difference of scope. by_source carries each source whole.

verdict.text: The registry's current submission for this Party is NDC 3.0, filed 2025-11-06. 48 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (2). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-35 78.5 MtCO₂e, DS-02 31.5 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. ND-GAIN scores it 40.7 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 13% reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to 1994, excluding Land-Use Change and Forestry (LUCF) It was classed conditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.15°C under SSP1-2.6 to +4.28°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
